### `devtools`

The `devtools` package [@Wickham_etal_2022] helps developing R packages. It is more commonly used to download R packages from [github](https://github.com){target='_blank'}.

### `FabioFun`

This is my personal package where I save functions that I use for research/teaching/convenience. You can run `devtools::install_github("quinix45/FabioFun")` to install it.
